description: Admins only (humans): recompute the daily agent metrics snapshot for THIS tenant now, for the days up to yesterday (Europe/Zurich) — the nightly job only covers yesterday plus 3 days. Optional: ab (YYYY-MM-DD, first day) or tage (number of days ending yesterday, default 7); at most 32 days per call, go in steps for longer. Writes a new version only where numbers changed (older versions are kept, each with erfasst_am). Returns which days got a new version.

tage.description: Number of days ending yesterday (default 7, max 32)

name: kennzahlen_nachrechnen
